name: Humanity’s Last Code Exam
intro: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) 收录 235 道顶级竞赛难题：146 道来自 2011-2023 年 ICPC 世界总决赛，89 道来自 2010-2024 年 IOI。ICPC 使用离线标准输入输出测试，IOI 通过自动提交机器人连接官方交互判题；基准还包含独立的自我识别任务。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
build_method: ICPC/IOI 官方题目, 人工与 ChatGPT 格式清理, 官方测试收集, 可解性过滤
eval_feature: 在线-离线统一判题, 标准 I/O 与交互题, 自我识别
build_method_en: Official ICPC/IOI Problems, Manual and ChatGPT Formatting, Official-Test Collection, Solvability Filtering
eval_feature_en: Harmonized Online-Offline Judging, Standard I/O and Interactive Tasks, Self-Recognition
intro_en: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) contains 235 elite competition problems: 146 from the 2011-2023 ICPC World Finals and 89 from IOI 2010-2024. ICPC uses an offline standard-I/O harness, while IOI uses an automated submission bot connected to the official interactive judge; the benchmark also includes a separate self-recognition task.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.12713v2 §3.1-§3.3, §4.1, and Appendix A.4 plus official repository snapshot 7ff3569. The paper constructs 146 ICPC World Finals problems from 2011-2023 and 89 IOI problems from 2010-2024, for 235 total, using official statements and tests while excluding corrupted, incompatible interactive, and output-only cases. Five OpenRouter-default responses are generated per problem. ICPC uses the offline standard-I/O harness; IOI uses the Codeforces submission bot and only score 100 passes. Pass@1/Pass@5 use 1-C(n-c,k)/C(n,k), while the separate self-recognition task uses AUC. Appendix A.4 specifies a 30 s ICPC timeout, but the current repository README command uses 60 s; the diagram exposes this paper-repository boundary rather than silently choosing one.
